take: Utah announced it placed left wing Michael Carcone on injured reserve and recalled defenseman Artem Duda from Tucson (AHL). Carcone has played five games this season with one goal and one assist, and Utah has controlled slightly less of the chance quality with him on the ice at five-on-five (about 48%) than without him. He plays 12:29 a night on the third line and second power-play unit. In the five games since he went out, Jack McBain has taken his spot beside But and Stenlund.
